newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-VILLA STRIKER MILOSEVIC COULD BE GOING TO ITALY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VILLA STRIKER MILOSEVIC COULD BE GOING TO ITALY.

text.p: Aston Villa's Yugoslav striker Savo Milosevic could be on his way to Italy -- with Perugia believed to be interested in signing him.
Milosevic, signed by Villa manager Brian Little for 3.5 million pounds sterling ($5.56 million) 15 months ago, has scored only 16 goals in 57 appearances for Villa -- and just two this season.
He was unhappy at being dropped for Saturday's home premier league match against Leeds United and left the ground before the kickoff.
If Milosevic does leave, Villa could use the money to bid for Liverpool's Stan Collymore.
Parma were interested in signing Milosevic before his move to Villa, and Roma also made an enquiry during the close-season.
Milosevic has struggled to adjust to the physical demands of English football but Little has remained patient with the striker he signed after watching him on video.
